question: What is the unit of electric current?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3) Ampere**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The unit of electric current is **Ampere**.
 
• An ampere (A) is defined as one coulomb of charge passing through a point in a circuit per second.
 
• It is one of the seven base units in the International System of Units (SI).
 
• The ampere is named after André-Marie Ampère, a French physicist and mathematician.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The measurement of electric current can be done using an instrument called an ammeter.
 
• Electric current is a fundamental concept in the field of electricity and electronics, influencing the design and functioning of various electrical devices and systems.
 
• Other important electrical units include the volt (unit of electric potential), the ohm (unit of electrical resistance), and the watt (unit of power).
